params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). In the lower half of the frame: a row of seven identical tall dark glass showcase cabinets with thin brass edges standing on a dark stone floor of a dark showroom, seen from the front with only a gentle perspective so all seven are clearly visible and similar in size, evenly spaced across the full width. Each showcase holds one object on a low dark pedestal. Showcase 1 (leftmost) is lit from inside with a warm yellow (#FDD506) glow: an open laptop whose screen shows an abstract website layout with placeholder blocks. Showcases 2-7 are dim, their objects visible only by a faint warm rim light: 2 - a neat stack of printed presentation pages with layout blocks; 3 - a smartphone on a small stand playing a vertical video, tiny play triangle; 4 - a small monthly calendar board with pinned cards; 5 - a dark tablet showing a rising line chart; 6 - a small dark city map with a few tiny glowing pins under a magnifying glass; 7 - a smartphone showing chat bubbles. Thin haze, subtle golden dust in the light beam. The upper 55% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm, one-of-seven mood.
